modelOverview: The Annual Calendar 5205 is a mid-size (40mm) complication from Patek Philippe's Complications collection, combining an annual calendar (day, date, month) with a 24-hour indication and moon phase display in a sub-dial at 6 o'clock. Introduced in white gold in 2010 and expanded with further dial and metal variations since, it is powered throughout by the self-winding Calibre 324 S QA LU 24H/206. The 5205G-013, with its striking sunburst blue dial, was added to the white gold line-up in 2018.

5205G-013.movement: Automatic · Patek Philippe Calibre 324 S QA LU 24H/206 · ~35-45h power reserve
5205G-013.materials: 18k white gold case on black alligator leather strap with white gold folding clasp
5205G-013.dial: Sunburst blue dial with black gradient rim, white gold baton hour markers and hands, annual calendar apertures for day/date/month across the upper arc, combined 24-hour indication and moon phase sub-dial at 6 o'clock
5205G-013.description: The 5205G-013 is the white gold Annual Calendar with a sunburst blue dial, added to the 5205 range in 2018. It displays day, date and month through a trio of apertures arched across the top of the dial, with a combined 24-hour indicator and moon phase at 6 o'clock, all driven by the self-winding Calibre 324 S QA LU 24H/206. Every piece we offer is professionally sourced and authenticated.
